description: Save a project as a template of the workspace: its statuses, custom fields, milestones and (unless issues=false) its open issues with their checklists, unticked, and (unless subprojects=false) its sub-projects. People, comments, files, clients and field values are not kept; dates stay relative to today.

issues.description: default true: keep the issues and checklists as starter tasks

name.description: template name; default = the project name

subprojects.description: default true: keep its sub-projects in the template

name: save_project_as_template
